```python
# SPECTRA design program: NMOS wide-swing cascode sink mirror, SKY130 1.8 V
# Revision 5: reference cascode diode-connected on iin so that the
# reference and output cascode Vds are matched by construction.

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_c": (18.0, 14.0, 22.0),   # cascode gm/Id
    "gmid_b": (22.0, 16.0, 24.0),   # bottom gm/Id (higher -> lower Vdsat)
    "Lc":     (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),     # cascode channel length [um]
    "Lb":     (10.0, 4.0, 10.0),    # bottom channel length [um] (long -> low gds)
    "vm":     (0.12, 0.10, 0.16),   # margin of yo above Vdsat_b [V]
}

VDD = 1.8
VDS_BR_DESIGN = 0.25  # Vds assumed for the reference bottom device at sizing time


def design(p, lut, spec):
    i_in = spec["iin"]
    i_out = spec["iout_target"]
    v_nom = spec["vout_nom"]

    # --- Device sizing: same gm/Id and L within each pair => exact ratio via W ---
    cr = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], i_in, vds=0.6)
    co = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], i_out, vds=0.6)
    br = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], i_in, vds=VDS_BR_DESIGN)
    bo = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["Lb"], i_out, vds=VDS_BR_DESIGN)

    # --- Bottom gate: diode Mg (same size as br) sinks i_in through Rg from VDD ---
    rg = (VDD - br.vgs) / i_in

    # --- Output bottom source level: yo = Vdsat_b + vm ---
    yo = bo.vdsat + p["vm"]

    # --- Netlist ---
    # Reference cascode diode-connected on iin: Vds_cr = Vgs_cr.
    # Output cascode gate shares iin, so Vgs_co is set by the same node.
    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.dev("Mcr", "iin", "iin", "xr", "vss", cr)
    n.dev("Mbr", "xr", "g", "vss", "vss", br)
    n.dev("Mco", "iout", "iin", "yo", "vss", co)
    n.dev("Mbo", "yo", "g", "vss", "vss", bo)
    n.dev("Mg", "g", "g", "vss", "vss", br)
    n.R("Rg", "vdd", "g", rg)

    # --- First-order predictions ---
    rout_pred = co.gm / (co.gds * bo.gds)

    # Current error from Vds mismatch:
    #   reference cascode Vds = Vgs_cr (diode), output cascode Vds = v_nom - yo
    #   bottom devices: output bottom Vds = yo, reference bottom Vds = VDS_BR_DESIGN
    vds_co = v_nom - yo
    dI_casc = co.gds * (vds_co - cr.vgs)
    dI_bottom = bo.gds * (yo - VDS_BR_DESIGN)
    err_pred = 100.0 * (dI_casc + dI_bottom) / i_out

    v_comp_pred = yo

    power_pred = VDD * 2.0 * i_in

    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": err_pred,
        "rout": rout_pred,
        "v_compliance": v_comp_pred,
        "power": power_pred,
    }
```
